notes: Footnote 1: maximum trailering ratings are intended for comparison purposes only; the weight of passengers, cargo and options or accessories may reduce the amount you can trailer.
GCWR includes the weight of the vehicle and trailer combination, including driver, passengers, fuel, optional equipment and cargo.
Maximum trailer weight rating = GCWR minus curb weight, with 150 lbs each for a driver and a front passenger (guide p. 7).
Trailer tongue weight should be 10% to 15% of total loaded trailer weight; it must not cause the vehicle to exceed RGAWR, GVWR or Max Trailer Tongue Load.
Guide also prints gooseneck/5th-wheel ratings for Silverado 1500 (pp. 28-30), not captured here.
Where available, the Trailering Package (Z82) provides a trailer hitch platform and 7-pin and 4-pin sealed connectors at the rear bumper.
2024 footnotes 3-6 (p. 27): with available 18" MT tires (R3O) or 20" MT tires (QFV), Crew Cab 4x4 ratings drop (or change) to 8,900 / 9,200 / 8,800 / 9,100 lbs; see config notes.
